responsibility: Provides GCC’s internal freestanding implementation of the standard integer-types interface by turning compiler predefined type and limit macros into the typedefs, limit constants, literal-construction macros, width macros, and version feature macros expected from <stdint.h>. It owns the exact-, least-, fast-, pointer-, and max-width integer definitions for environments that rely directly on GCC’s builtin type model instead of a hosted system header.
